value.text: Hmm. Do you see that door to your left, dear? There's no handle, but I think an explosion could blast it apart. Missiles are traditional, but any explosive should do.
Watch out, the Floran of thiss region are famouss for being very ssavage. Even other floranss fear them.
A dead end? This isn't right...
Wait. Do you see that patch of floral ground there? The yellow ones? Try digging it up with your matter manipulator.
Excellent work, dear! I think the lack of shielding was creating that irregularity. I'm sure there're more to be found - keep an eye out for odd changes in the walls!
Ixodoom husbandry iss a revered sskill amongsst the floran. Ixolingss raissed in thesse cavernss are brought to other planetss to grow.
Do you remember the Ixodoom we fought? It may even have come from here!
You have to wonder why ancient ruins are always filled with traps. Was it a major architectural movement amongst these people?
Reflective. I don't know about that, but it certainly makes for good exploring!
What an impressive lithograph. No doubt this was carved by ancient hands, too... I wonder what those words mean?
I might go and have a look myself once it's safe to do so.
I think I'll come along as well, and I'm not taking no for an answer.
It looks much cruder than the other ones we've seen so far. And much larger, too.
Confident. I scaled statues like this all the time in my youth. Surely you can do so as well!
After all this work...I think there's some kind of final puzzle here. Have you discovered any clues while here, dear?

terminology_notes: İki kısa saldırı emri aynı sırayla ve Floran tıslamasıyla korundu. Tek başına Sapla! silah nesnesi eksiltili savaş emridir;önceki Büyük Arena düzeltmesindeki düşmanları saplamak gibi doğrudan yanlış nesne yapısı burada yoktur. Köyü koruma emri korunur. Kaynak bu kısa replikte uzatılmış s içermediği için Türkçeye zorunlu tıslama sözcüğü eklenmedi.
Mighty powers muazzam güçler olarak saldırı tehdidi düzeyinde korunur. İlahi varlık,belirli yetenek veya ölçülen hasar/etki eklenmedi.
Üç ayrı saplama emri/tekrar parçası ve sonra bir daha sırası korunur. Eksiltili Floran saldırı söylemi,canlı saldırı mekaniği onayı değildir.

Kutsal topraklara izinsiz girmeye cüret edenin sorulması,soru biçimi ve Floran tıslaması korunur. Floran/default konuşmacı türü dalıdır;hedef Floran değildir.
